detailed_description:
The target video is a STILL IMAGE - a frozen reference data sheet in flat product-photography style,
with no motion from the first frame to the last: a seamless neutral mid-grey background, soft even
studio light from the front and both sides so every surface is readable and nothing falls into black
shadow, neutral accurate colour, no stylised grading, no environment.

THE SUBJECT IS A PERSON, and their identity is what this sheet exists to lock. The SAME individual in
every one of the eight panels: same face shape and features, eye spacing and colour, nose, mouth,
jaw, hairline, hair, complexion and build; age, weight and bone structure do not change between
panels. The expression is the same in all eight: calm and neutral, mouth closed, eyes open, lit the
same way throughout. Neither person nor outfit is redesigned, restyled, slimmed or embellished.

<Subject 1> IS FULLY DRESSED IN <Outfit 1> IN EVERY ONE OF THE EIGHT PANELS AND IN NOTHING ELSE.
Each garment is worn normally: the top on the torso, covering chest, stomach, back and shoulders
down to where it ends; the lower garment on legs and hips; the footwear on the feet, fitted to this
person's build. The torso is clothed in every panel, front, side, back and close-ups alike. Bare
skin appears ONLY where <Outfit 1> leaves it uncovered - head, neck, hands, forearms if the sleeves
are short. The person is never shirtless, bare-chested, stripped to the waist or in underwear; no
garment is left off, opened, pulled aside or made transparent to show the body underneath. Wherever
a reference shows them undressed, <Outfit 1> is put on over that and covers it completely.

TAKE ONLY THE PERSON THEMSELVES from the identity references. Where one is a close-up, place what it
shows on the matching part of the body - a tattooed shoulder means that shoulder carries that exact
tattoo, under the sleeve where the sleeve covers it. Their rooms, furniture, scenery, other people,
objects and light are ignored.

[Shot 1] The frame is a grid of panels on that grey background, separated by thin even neutral-grey
gutters of equal width, with a matching margin around the outside. Every panel is a plain rectangle,
flat to the camera, with no tilt, no perspective and no drop shadow.

TOP ROW - FOUR FULL VIEWS, equal panels side by side, the whole subject in each, shown at exactly
the same scale, at the same height, upright and level, centred in its own panel, lit identically,
photographed from the same camera height and distance. Only the viewing angle differs:
  1 - FRONT, facing the camera straight on
  2 - THREE-QUARTER, turned 45 degrees to its own right
  3 - SIDE, a STRICT profile at exactly 90 degrees: the camera sees only one side of the subject,
      the far arm and far leg are hidden behind the near ones, and the face is seen edge-on with the
      nose in silhouette. This panel must be clearly different from panel 2, not a second
      three-quarter view.
  4 - BACK, seen from directly behind

BOTTOM ROW - FOUR CLOSE-UPS, equal panels side by side, each a tight crop on one main area of the
same subject, filling its panel, on the same grey background and in the same light. The four areas
are DIFFERENT from each other and each appears ONCE. No two of these panels show the same area, the
same framing or the same crop, and none of them repeats another:
  5 - HEAD AND SHOULDERS: the face, head and shoulders, front-on.
  6 - CHEST AND WAIST: the clothed torso and the waistline of the outfit, front-on, showing how the
      garments sit and fasten there. No head in frame. The torso is clothed in this panel too.
  7 - ARM AND HAND: one whole arm from shoulder to fingertips, with the hand open and clearly visible.
  8 - LEG AND FOOT: one whole leg from hip to the ground, with the foot clearly visible.
Any angle or crop the references do not already contain is built from the ones that do, keeping the
same silhouette, garment shapes, layering and proportions. Each close-up is shot STRAIGHT ON, square
to that part of the subject, filling its panel, with no tilt and no oblique angle; the head close-up
faces the camera front-on, not turned to the side.

It is one and the same person in the same outfit in every panel, top row and bottom row alike, with
the same face, build, colours and proportions. The back view belongs to the same person as the front
view, and each close-up belongs to the same person as the full views.

POSE - in the four full views the person stands in a relaxed A-pose, feet shoulder width apart, arms
held slightly away from the body with open hands and separated fingers, head level and facing along
the body, the same pose in all four.

This is a FROZEN FRAME. Nothing moves at all. The camera holds a static shot and does not move,
zoom, tilt, shake or drift. The panels do not slide, resize, reorder, cross-fade or animate. The
subject does not move, turn, gesture, breathe or change pose inside any panel. Every frame is
identical to the first: the shot reads as a single photograph, not as a video.

No text, letters, numbers, captions, labels, arrows, callouts, measurement lines, colour swatches,
logos or watermarks anywhere in the frame or the gutters, no second copy of the subject inside a
panel, no repeated panel, no two panels showing the same area or crop, no extra, empty or
overlapping panels, no other object or person, no second face, no change of identity, age or build
between panels, no bare chest, no bare torso, no shirtless panel, no exposed stomach, no underwear,
no partial nudity, no clothing from any reference other than <Picture 1>, no mixing of two outfits,
no substituted top, trousers or shoes, no missing garment in one panel that is present in another,
no environment, no floor pattern, no cast shadow on the background, no camera movement, no cuts, no
fades, no motion blur, no depth-of-field blur, no stylised or cartoon rendering, no dramatic or
coloured lighting, no lens flare, no smoke or atmosphere.
